decision: NEW MODEL (unassigned; no identifier may be allocated by this audit)

identityTest.stableIdentity: A produced or received bulk cohort remains identifiable independently of serialized members, product type and production order.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Corrections preserve the stable lot identity and append provenance assertions rather than reusing identifiers.
identityTest.mastership: authorized bulk-cohort identity and lot-genealogy authority (cohort identity only; no composition state)

invariants: Lot codes are issuer and scheme scoped.
A lot is not a serialized instance.
Lot membership is provenance, not identity.
Quantities carry unit, basis and unit code-list version.
Splits and merges preserve parent provenance.
Lot-based effectivity requires a resolvable lot.
Missing evidence remains explicitly unknown and never defaults to zero, absent or not-applicable.
Identifiers are never reused; retirement writes a tombstone and the retired identifier stays resolvable.
This model never asserts as-built composition state.
